name: EL SALVADOR

flag.title: Blue–White–Blue
flag.note: Blue stripes for the ocean; white for peace

lead: El Salvador is the smallest country in Central America. It has over 20 volcanoes, coffee forests and Pacific surf beaches. The Pipil people farmed here before the Spanish came in 1524.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: El Salvador sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire. Santa Ana is the highest volcano, at 2,381 m. It has a crater lake and last erupted in 2005.
The Pacific coast is 307 km long. It is the country's only coast, so it has no Caribbean shore. Pine highlands drop to valleys where coffee and sugar cane grow.
animals: The national bird is the turquoise-browed motmot, called the torogoz. It swings its long racket-tipped tail like a pendulum. Sea turtles nest on the Pacific beaches.
White-tailed deer, coatis and ocelots live in the highland forests. More than 500 bird species have been recorded here.
culture: Pupusas are thick cornmeal patties filled with cheese, beans or pork. People eat them with curtido, a tangy pickled cabbage.
Coffee has shaped the country since the 1880s. Festivals mix Catholic traditions with old Pipil dances and marimba music.
history: The Pipil people, related to the Aztecs, ruled here. Spanish conquistador Pedro de Alvarado arrived in 1524. Pipil warriors beat the first invasion. Spain needed three tries to win.
A civil war from 1979 to 1992 killed over 75,000 people. Peace accords ended it. In 2021, El Salvador became the first country to make Bitcoin official money. It reversed this in 2025.
wows: El Salvador is the only Central American country with no Caribbean coast.
Joya de Cerén, a Maya village, was buried in ash around AD 600. People call it the Pompeii of the Americas.
Over 20 volcanoes squeeze into a space the size of Wales.
The torogoz swings its tail like a pendulum to show predators it has been spotted.
Indigo dye was the top export for 300 years, until cheap synthetic dyes ended the trade.
In 2021, it was the first nation to make Bitcoin legal tender.
Pupusa Day is a national holiday on the second Sunday of November.

myths.fact: They are seeds inside a red fruit called a coffee cherry. Each cherry usually holds two seeds.

myths.myth: El Salvador is named after a man called Salvador
myths.fact: The name is Spanish for 'The Saviour'. It honours Jesus Christ.
